def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    n = int(data[0])
    q = int(data[1])
    
    record = [(i, 0) for i in range(1, n+1)]
    direction_map = {"R": (1, 0), "L": (-1, 0), "U": (0, 1), "D": (0, -1)}
    
    index = 2
    for _ in range(q):
        select = data[index]
        part = data[index + 1]
        index += 2
        
        if select == "1":
            dx, dy = direction_map[part]
            x, y = record[0]
            record[0] = (x + dx, y + dy)
            
            for i in range(1, n):
                record[i] = record[i - 1]
        
        elif select == "2":
            part = int(part)
            print(*record[part - 1])
